subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Miscellaneous runtime helper objects around menu presentation and object lifecycle: menu-option value display with bounded string-buffer replace (0x004673B0, 0x00467430), menu layout/HTML-section processing over embedded linked lists (0x00467DC0, 0x00467F90), menu navigation index selection (0x00470040), a family of season-database object constructors/destructors called from SeasonDatabaseObjectFactory (0x0047F440), a controller shifter/gear action-binding manager (0x0046A9C0), an input-binding dispatch (0x0046D270), a driver index lookup-table initializer (0x0046CB10), a state-change monitor (0x0046EFE0), a debug line-render helper (0x00475C80), a HUD text-node destructor (0x00476600), and a grab-bag of GenericRuntimeObject constructors/destructors following the MSVC base-init + vtable-install + conditional-free protocol.

summary: Derived architecture proposal for 36 validated functions in scope generic_runtime_objects. One DERIVED two-method class MenuOptionValueDisplay (0x004673B0 value formatter + 0x00467430 bounded string replace with vtable-slot-11 change signal) covers the menu-option text path; one GUESS two-method class MenuLayoutProcessor (0x00467DC0 layout calculator + 0x00467F90 HTML output section processor) shares the same this, a secondary list at 0x44..0x50 and a primary list at 0xF8..0x108; one GUESS MenuNavigationController (0x00470040) selects a UI list index from global mode dword_7D0410 and a session flag. Seven constructors/init functions called from SeasonDatabaseObjectFactory (0x0047F440) plus the season-database variant teardown pair 0x0046B5C0/0x0046B5E0 are grouped into a GUESS SeasonDatabaseObject class (distinct vtables 0x0059FA98/0x0059FE18/0x0059FED0/0x005A0250/0x005A4370/0x005A44A0; variants not merged). Single-function GUESS classes: HudTextNode (0x00476600 three-level vtable chain destructor), ControllerBindingSlot (0x0046A9C0 action pair + force-feedback table), InputBindingConfigurator (0x0046D270 sound refresh + binding factory at vtable slot 0x1C), DriverIndexTable (0x0046CB10 global table init), StateChangeMonitor (0x0046EFE0 cached-state diff), DebugRenderSystem (0x00475C80 red-line draw gate, packet-DERIVED owner). The remaining 18 UNKNOWN-owner constructors/destructors are grouped into a GUESS GenericRuntimeObject grab-bag that shares the base-init + vtable-install + conditional-free protocol but not a proven layout; per-function field offsets are NOT merged into that class and are carried in unresolved_evidence_refs instead. 0x00469872 is flagged unreliable (reported stack-pointer imbalance, uninitialized base). All class assignments are proposals, never CONFIRMED.

function_roles.role: Menu-option value display formatter: seeds a 61-byte local buffer from byte_5EA438, dispatches on selection type this+0x32C (==4 to VehicleSetupValueFormatter(byte_7C56C0, this+0x324), else SetupValueFormatDispatcher(byte_7C56C0, this+0x32C, this+0x328)), formats the value string 30 bytes past this+0x320 into the buffer via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck, then calls StringCompareAndConditionalReplace to replace the display only when changed

Conditional string replace on the option-text buffer: returns -1 when the input is null or strcmp-equal to the buffer at this+0x2F0; otherwise bounded-copies (limit this+0x2F8 minus 1) via sub_587DD0, null-terminates, resets the position pointer this+0x2F4 and advances it to the null terminator, then signals the change through vtable slot 11 (vtable + 0x2C) with argument 1; returns 0 on replace

Combined init + linked-list clear: installs vtable off_59F5B8 via InitWithVTableFlags(this,0,0), zeroes counters 0xE4..0xF0, walks the embedded singly-linked list from this+0xF8 (node layout data@+0, next@+4, flag@+8), frees each flagged payload chain and node through FreeWrapper_7bcf, then resets head/tail/count/capacity fields and the 0xF4/0xF5 flag bytes

Menu layout calculator: runs CreditsTxtParser (0x00467E40) then HTMLOutputSectionProcessor (0x00467F90) on this, computes the horizontal center this+0xEC as midpoint of bounds this+0x4 and this+0x8, then loads a resource via sub_497AD0(this+0x40, path=this+0xB8 or default byte_5EA438, key 0) storing the handle at this+0x108; returns 0

HTML output-section processor: seeds traversal this+0x100 from the primary list head this+0xF8, destroys the secondary list anchored at this+0x44 (DestructorWithDoubleFreePattern per node) and clears its four fields, then walks the primary list comparing each node payload (defaulting to byte_5EA438 when null) against Header literal aHeader_0 via sub_588410; a Header match that is not aHeader2 is inserted with LinkedListInsertWithNodeAllocation(string,-1), non-matches advance to the next node
Scalar-deleting destructor: runs DestructorWithFree(this) (0x00468610) then, only when delete flag a2 bit 0 is set, releases the object via FreeWrapper_7bcf(this); returns this

Object destructor: restores vtable off_59F718 at offset 0, conditionally frees the heap sub-object at this+0x174 via FreeWrapper_7bcf when non-null, then delegates to a cleanup wrapper and returns its result

Unreliable reconstruction (reported stack-pointer imbalance, base v1 uninitialized, indirect call through (v1-117)): writes vtable off_59F7C8 and constants 0/-1/1 at ungrounded offsets v1+372..v1+388, calls sub_4893C0 and StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(0); nothing grounded beyond the raw text

Scalar-deleting destructor: frees the heap sub-object at this+0x180 via FreeWrapper_7bcf when non-null, runs FunctionCallWrapper_9440(this) (0x00489440) as cleanup, then frees this when delete flag a2 bit 0 is set; returns this
Scalar-deleting destructor: runs VtableSetSubCall() (0x0046A970) then frees this via FreeWrapper_7bcf when delete flag a2 bit 0 is set; returns this

Controller shifter/gear binding: clears the previous ID pair via IDPairMatchAndClear(this+128), writes the two-ID pair (this+0x200, this+0x204) at a stride-28 slot indexed by this+0x1F4 into dword_7D1B08/dword_7D1B0C, and when the first ID equals 1 switches on this+0x204 (jump table jpt_46AA0C) to seed a force-feedback value 1056964608 into dword_7D1490[216*result+27*v6] after a linear scan over dword_7D1B0C
Scalar-deleting destructor for the season-database variant: runs VTableSetAndInit() (0x0046B5E0) then frees this via FreeWrapper_7bcf when delete flag a2 bit 0 is set; returns this
Object init entry for the season-database variant: writes vtable off_59FA98 into this->vtable at offset 0x0 and delegates to FunctionCallWrapper_9440(this), returning its result
Constructor: runs base/sub-object initializer sub_4893C0(this), stores the byte parameter a2 at this+0x174, installs vtable off_59FB58 at offset 0x0, returns this

Driver index lookup-table init: gates on GlobalSignCheck (0x0046CB00), then for i in 0..103 reads live driver identifier dword_7CD470[i]; when non-negative writes the loop counter i into the driver table dword_5F0730 at entry 4656*v1; returns 1 on success, 0 on gate failure

Input-binding dispatch: refreshes the sound system dword_5EB10C via vtable offset 12 when non-null, re-initializes input buffer flt_5EA618 with BufferInitWith10fDefaults, creates UI binding objects IDs 39 and 41 through the vtable factory at offset 0x1C on the object at this+0x40, activates 39 (sub_47C360 param 1) and deactivates 41 (param 0), then refreshes game state dword_5EB978; returns 0
Constructor: runs ConstructorWithByteParams(this,0,0) (0x00487220) then binds vtable off_59FC08 at offset 0x0; returns this
Constructor: runs ConstructorWithByteParams(this,0,0) (0x00487220) then sets vtable slot at offset 0x0 to off_59FCB8; returns this
Object init entry: writes vtable off_59FCB8 into this->vtable at offset 0x0 and delegates to InitWithVTableCleanup(this), returning its result; called from a SubCallConditionalFree destructor

Constructor-style initializer (season-database factory step, caller 0x0047F440): runs base initializer sub_4893C0(this), installs vtable off_59FE18 at offset 0x0, zeroes the byte field at this+0x174; returns this

Constructor (season-database factory init path, caller 0x0047F440): runs base initializer sub_4893C0(this), installs vtable off_59FED0 at offset 0x0, sets the signed dword at this+0x174 to -1 as an invalid-state sentinel; returns this

State-change monitor with deferred update: reads current state via VtableGetterAtOffset0x1c (0x00432A60) on global dword_7C73E0, compares to cached this+0x174, and on any difference runs ExtensionStripperForAllListEntries(this) (0x0046F170) then re-caches the new value; always returns 0
Constructor: runs ConstructorWithByteParams(this,0,0) (0x00487220), stores integer parameter a2 at this+0xE4, assigns vtable off_59FF80 at offset 0x0; returns this
Constructor: runs ConstructorWithByteParams(this,0,0) (0x00487220), stores byte parameter a2 at this+0xE4, installs vtable off_5A0040 at offset 0x0; returns this

Object factory (userpurge signature, object in eax / interface in esi): invokes the interface callback at interface offset 0x6A, runs base constructor ConstructorWithByteParams with two byte parameters, stores input byte a2 at object offset 0xE4, installs vtable off_5A00F0 at the object head; returns the new object
Scalar-deleting destructor: runs InitWithVTableCleanup() teardown (0x00487250) then frees this via FreeWrapper_7bcf when delete flag a2 bit 0 is set; returns this

Menu navigation dispatch: returns early when the session-flag pointer this+0xE8 is null; otherwise selects UI list index 0/1 from the pointed-to flag when global dword_7D0410 equals 3 or 5, or fallback index 2 otherwise, stores the index at this+0xE0, copies the selected list entry string via UIListIndexedAccessor (0x00487010) + StringCopyWithBufferRealloc into this+0xEC, and dispatches navigation through vtable slot 0x40

Constructor (season-database factory, caller 0x0047F440): delegates to ConstructorWithStringCopy(this,0,0,0,0,1,0) (0x0048B420), then overwrites the vtable pointer at this+0x0 with off_5A0250; returns this
Scalar-deleting destructor: runs VTableSetterSubCall_b4e0 (0x0048B4E0) on this then frees this via FreeWrapper_7bcf when delete flag a2 bit 0 is set; returns this
Constructor: delegates to ConstructorWithStringCopy(this,0,0,0,0,1,0) (0x0048B420), stores integer parameter a2 at this+0x304, assigns vtable off_5A0308 at offset 0x0; returns this
Scalar-deleting destructor: runs VTableInit (0x0048C0D0) on this then frees this via FreeWrapper_7bcf when delete flag a2 bit 0 is set; returns this
UI-object constructor: delegates to ConstructorWithByteParams(this,0,0) (0x00487220), stores integer parameter a2 at this+0xE4, installs vtable off_5A42C0 at offset 0x0; returns this

Season-database object init (factory context 0x0047F440): calls sub_4893C0 for generic setup, zeroes dwords at this+0x174 and this+0x178 and a byte at this+0x17C, installs vtable off_5A4370 at offset 0x0; returns this

Debug red-line renderer (caller 0x00475A90): queries render-debug enable state via GlobalAccessor_5150 on unk_7CDE00; when enabled draws a red line (color 16711680) between the two 2D points a1 and a2 through FloatVectorWithConditionalTransform passing the enable result as the final argument; returns the enable result when disabled

HUD text-node destructor: walks the base-class chain writing three successive vtable pointers to this+0x0 (off_5A448C, off_5A4450, off_5A443C), freeing a child object after each step (offsets 0x3C, 0x30, 0x4) when non-null; finally frees this when delete flag a2 bit 0 is set; returns this

Constructor for an object holding a season/context identifier (caller 0x0047F440): calls LargeConstructor (0x0048EAA0), sets the vtable pointer at this+0x0 to off_5A44A0, stores parameter a2 at this+0x180, initializes this+0x184 and this+0x18C to -1 and this+0x188 to 0; returns this

classes.name: MenuOptionValueDisplay
classes.responsibility: Menu-option value display: formats the option value (selection-type dispatch at 0x32C, value block at 0x320) into a scratch buffer and replaces the held text string only when it changed. Owns the string buffer region 0x2F0..0x2F8 and the value/selection region 0x320..0x32C. The vtable slot-11 change signal (vtable + 0x2C, argument 1) is the observable external contract of the replace step.

classes.name: MenuLayoutProcessor
classes.responsibility: Menu layout/HTML-section processing over two embedded singly-linked lists: a secondary list at 0x44..0x50 destroyed per node, and a primary list at 0xF8..0x108 traversed while filtering Header literals. Computes the horizontal center from bounds 0x4/0x8 and loads a resource (path 0xB8, default global byte_5EA438, handle stored at 0x108).

classes.name: MenuNavigationController
classes.responsibility: Menu navigation dispatch: selects a UI list index (0, 1, or 2) from the global mode dword_7D0410 and a pointed session flag, copies the selected list entry string, and dispatches navigation through vtable slot 0x40.

classes.name: SeasonDatabaseObject
classes.responsibility: Family of season-database objects constructed/initialized from SeasonDatabaseObjectFactory (0x0047F440) plus the season-database variant teardown pair 0x0046B5C0/0x0046B5E0. Holds a state/flag region at 0x174..0x17C, an identifier at 0x180, and -1/0 sentinel indices at 0x184..0x18C. Six distinct vtables (0x0059FA98, 0x0059FE18, 0x0059FED0, 0x005A0250, 0x005A4370, 0x005A44A0) mean sub-variants are plausible; the fields below are the union across members and do not claim one identical layout.

classes.name: HudTextNode
classes.responsibility: UI text node whose destructor walks a three-level base-class chain (vtables 0x005A448C, 0x005A4450, 0x005A443C) freeing one child object per level (0x3C, 0x30, 0x4). Class hierarchy order is inferred from the vtable pointer sequence, not confirmed.

classes.name: ControllerBindingSlot
classes.responsibility: Controller shifter/gear binding slot: clears the prior ID pair, writes a two-ID pair at a stride-28 entry of the global action tables (dword_7D1B08/dword_7D1B0C) indexed by this+0x1F4, and, when the primary ID is a gear action, seeds a force-feedback table (dword_7D1490) through a jump-table switch on the secondary ID.

classes.name: InputBindingConfigurator
classes.responsibility: Input-binding dispatch: refreshes the sound system, re-initializes the input buffer, creates UI binding objects (IDs 39 and 41) through the vtable factory at offset 0x1C on the object stored at this+0x40, activates one and deactivates the other, then refreshes game state.

classes.name: DriverIndexTable
classes.responsibility: Initializes the driver index lookup table: gates on GlobalSignCheck, reads live driver identifiers from dword_7CD470 (0..103) and writes the loop counter into the driver table dword_5F0730 at stride 4656 per driver. Operates on globals only; no instance fields.

classes.name: StateChangeMonitor
classes.responsibility: Cached-state change monitor: reads a module-callback state via vtable slot 0x1C on global dword_7C73E0, compares to the cached value at this+0x174, and on change runs ExtensionStripperForAllListEntries on itself then re-caches.

classes.name: DebugRenderSystem
classes.responsibility: Debug rendering helper: queries the render-debug enable state on global unk_7CDE00 and, when enabled, draws a red line between two 2D points through FloatVectorWithConditionalTransform. Packet owner trust DERIVED; operates on globals only, no instance fields.

classes.name: GenericRuntimeObject
classes.responsibility: Grab-bag of 18 UNKNOWN-owner constructors/destructors/init entries sharing the object-lifecycle protocol (base initializer delegate + vtable install at offset 0 + conditional-free teardown) but not a proven shared layout. Per-function vtables differ (0x0059F5B8, 0x0059F718, 0x0059F7C8, 0x0059FB58, 0x0059FC08, 0x0059FCB8, 0x0059FF80, 0x005A0040, 0x005A00F0, 0x005A0308, 0x005A42C0), so each method likely belongs to a distinct class; only the vtable-at-0 convention is asserted here, all other per-function field offsets are carried in unresolved_evidence_refs rather than merged.

state_machines.name: MenuOptionValueFormatSelector
states: selection type 4: vehicle-setup value formatter path
any other selection type: generic value-format dispatcher path
transitions: dispatches on this+0x32C: equals 4 selects VehicleSetupValueFormatter(byte_7C56C0, this+0x324); otherwise SetupValueFormatDispatcher(byte_7C56C0, this+0x32C, this+0x328)

state_machines.name: ControllerActionPairingSwitch
states: gear/shifter action pairing states selected by secondary action ID this+0x204
transitions: switch on this+0x204 via jump table jpt_46AA0C (global:0x0046AC58) with lookup data byte_46ACDC, pairing each action value with a counterpart v5, a force-feedback index group v6 and a flag result; default case returns early

state_machines.name: MenuNavigationModeSelector
states: race-mode branch: index 0 (flag byte non-zero) or index 1 (flag byte zero)
transitions: global dword_7D0410 equal to 3 or 5 selects the flag-dependent branch using the byte pointed to by this+0xE8; any other value selects index 2; the chosen index is stored at this+0xE0 and dispatched via vtable slot 0x40

interfaces.name: IMenuOptionValueFormatter
interfaces.purpose: Format a menu-option value into the shared display buffer byte_7C56C0: either the vehicle-setup formatter (selection type 4) or the generic dispatcher; consumed by MenuOptionValueDisplay.

interfaces.name: IObjectLifecycleProtocol
interfaces.purpose: Constructor/destructor protocol shared by GenericRuntimeObject and SeasonDatabaseObject methods: delegate to a base initializer (sub_4893C0, ConstructorWithByteParams, ConstructorWithStringCopy, LargeConstructor, InitWithVTableFlags), install the derived vtable at offset 0, and for destructors run a teardown sub-call then conditionally free via FreeWrapper_7bcf when the deleting-flag bit is set.

interfaces.name: IStringBufferUpdate
interfaces.purpose: Conditional string-buffer update with change notification: bounded copy (size limit minus 1), null-terminate, position-pointer reset/advance, then vtable slot 11 (offset 0x2C) invoked with argument 1 to signal the change; used by MenuOptionValueDisplay.

compatibility_contracts.name: MenuOptionTextBufferLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: StringCompareAndConditionalReplace (0x00467430) requires a char buffer at this+0x2F0, a position pointer at this+0x2F4, a status byte at this+0x2F5 and a size limit at this+0x2F8; replacement copies at most (limit - 1) bytes, null-terminates, resets and advances the position pointer, then invokes vtable slot 11 (vtable + 0x2C) with argument 1. A replacement executable must preserve this layout and the change-signal callback.

compatibility_contracts.name: LinkedNodeContainerLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Embedded singly-linked-list container at this+0xF8 (head), 0xFC (tail), 0x100 (count), 0x104 (capacity), 0x108 (extra), with flag bytes at 0xF4/0xF5; list node layout is data at node+0, next at node+4, one-byte flag at node+8. Used by objectInitAndClearLinkedList (0x00467720) and the menu primary list in ProcessHtmlOutputSection (0x00467F90).

compatibility_contracts.name: MenuLayoutFieldLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: MenuLayoutCalculator (0x00467DC0) requires bounds at this+0x4 and this+0x8, a resource data pointer at this+0x40, a path string at this+0xB8 (defaulting to global byte_5EA438 when null), a computed center at this+0xEC and a loaded-resource handle at this+0x108. A replacement executable must preserve these offsets for menu layout.

compatibility_contracts.name: SeasonDatabaseObjectStateLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Season-database object family carries a state/flag dword at this+0x174 (zero, or -1 sentinel), zeroed counter fields at this+0x178 and this+0x17C, an identifier at this+0x180, and sentinel indices -1/-0/-1 at this+0x184/0x188/0x18C as written by 0x0046EEC0, 0x004750F0 and 0x004766F0. Six vtables are installed across the family (0x0059FA98, 0x0059FE18, 0x0059FED0, 0x005A0250, 0x005A4370, 0x005A44A0).

compatibility_contracts.name: ScalarDeletingDestructorFlag
compatibility_contracts.description: The conditional destructors (0x004685F0, 0x0046A950, 0x0046B5C0, 0x0046FD30, 0x00470250, 0x004713C0) follow the MSVC scalar-deleting-destructor convention: run the teardown sub-call on this, then free this via FreeWrapper_7bcf only when the low bit of the second argument (a2 & 1) is set; return this in all paths. A replacement executable must honor the delete-flag argument convention.

compatibility_contracts.name: DriverIndexTableStride
compatibility_contracts.description: DriverTableIndexInitialization (0x0046CB10) reads live driver identifiers from dword_7CD470 for i in 0..103 and, when an identifier v1 is non-negative, writes the loop counter i into the driver table dword_5F0730 at entry 4656*v1 (stride 4656 bytes per driver). A replacement executable must preserve this stride and the table addresses.

compatibility_contracts.name: VtableFactorySlots
compatibility_contracts.description: Three observed vtable/interface dispatch offsets: vtable offset 0x1C is the binding-object factory on the object stored at this+0x40 (0x0046D270), vtable offset 0x40 is the navigation dispatch receiving the selected index (0x00470040), and interface offset 0x6A is the callback invoked by the object factory (0x0046FCF9).

compatibility_contracts.name: InputActionBindingTables
compatibility_contracts.description: ControllerShifterMapping (0x0046A9C0) writes a two-ID pair into dword_7D1B08/dword_7D1B0C at a stride-28 slot indexed by this+0x1F4, scans dword_7D1B0C stepping 7 dwords up to dword_7D1FDC, and seeds a force-feedback value (float 0.001 precision literal 1056964608) into dword_7D1490[216*result + 27*v6]. A replacement executable must preserve these global table layouts.

unresolved: Identity and role of byte_7C56C0 (session-name buffer versus file-loader flag in prior analysis) is not established from this packet; it is only observed as the formatting target of MenuOptionValueDisplay.

byte_5EA438 is used in two ways across this packet: as the source of the first byte seeding the option format buffer (0x004673B0) and as a default directory/path string in the menu layout path (0x00467DC0, 0x00467F90). The relationship between these uses is unresolved.
Why the option value string begins 30 bytes into the block pointed to by this+0x320 is not resolvable without the value-block layout.
Semantics of the return value of StringCompareAndConditionalReplace (match indicator versus replace result) are not confirmed.
The status byte at this+0x2F5 is flagged as read by static evidence but is not referenced in the visible decompilation; purpose unknown.
The object type and the meaning of the slot-11 vtable callback's integer argument (1) invoked by StringCompareAndConditionalReplace are not established from this packet.

GenericRuntimeObject is a GUESS grab-bag: the 18 UNKNOWN-owner constructors/destructors each install a different vtable (0x0059F5B8, 0x0059F718, 0x0059F7C8, 0x0059FB58, 0x0059FC08, 0x0059FCB8, 0x0059FF80, 0x005A0040, 0x005A00F0, 0x005A0308, 0x005A42C0), so they most likely belong to distinct classes; only the vtable-at-offset-0 convention is asserted here.

Offset 0x174 collides across classes with unrelated meanings: freed sub-object pointer (0x00468610), stored byte parameter (0x0046C6F0), season-database state/flag (0x0046E7D0, 0x0046EEC0, 0x004750F0) and cached state dword (0x0046EFE0). The offsets are kept in their respective classes, not merged.
Offset 0x180 collides across classes: freed sub-object pointer (0x004698C0) versus season-database identifier (0x004766F0); not merged.
Offset 0xEC collides across classes: horizontal center in MenuLayoutProcessor (0x00467DC0) versus navigation text buffer in MenuNavigationController (0x00470040); not merged.
Offset 0x108 collides across classes: loaded-resource handle in MenuLayoutProcessor (0x00467DC0) versus unknown list-container field cleared by 0x00467720; not merged.

0x00469872 is unreliable: the decompiler reports a stack-pointer imbalance at a call, the base v1 is uninitialized, and the written offsets v1+372..v1+388 cannot be grounded; no class fields were derived from it.
FunctionCallWrapper_9440 (0x00489440) and InitWithVTableCleanup have no callee records for the functions that delegate to them (0x0046B5E0, 0x0046D6C0), so those wrapper targets are unresolved.
The a2 & 1 delete-flag convention is DERIVED (standard MSVC scalar-deleting-destructor pattern), not confirmed by packet evidence.

The SeasonDatabaseObject grouping is based on the caller name SeasonDatabaseObjectFactory (0x0047F440) and legacy analysis labels; the six distinct vtables mean sub-variants are plausible but not resolvable here.
The meaning of the -1 sentinel and 0 initialization at 0x184..0x18C and of the stored identifier at this+0x180 in 0x004766F0 is not stated by the packet.
The individual counter fields at 0xE4..0xF0 and flag bytes 0xF4/0xF5 cleared by 0x00467720 have unknown semantics.
Field this+0x104 is extracted as read by ProcessHtmlOutputSection but no use is visible in the raw source.
The exact meaning of the aHeader_0 (0x005C6720) / aHeader2 (0x005C6714) comparisons beyond Header detection is not established.
The menu layout bounds this+0x4 / this+0x8 and the purpose of the this+0x40 pointer passed to sub_497AD0 are unknown beyond their call sites.
ControllerShifterMapping writes literal 1056964608 into the force-feedback table; its float interpretation is not derived here.
Whether dword_7D1B08/dword_7D1B0C and dword_7D1490 are per-bind arrays indexed by this+0x1F4 depends on caller conventions not present in the packet.
The semantics of global dword_7D0410 values 3 and 5 (race/championship mode per legacy analysis) and of the pointed session flag at this+0xE8 in 0x00470040 are not resolved independently here.
The vtable slot at offset 0x40 in 0x00470040 is assumed to be the navigation dispatch because it receives the selected index; that is inferred, not proven.
The HUD text-node destructor (0x00476600) base-class chain order is inferred from the vtable pointer sequence; whether FreeWrapper_7bcf is a heap free or a virtual operator delete is unresolved.
DrawRedLineIfEnabled's sixth argument to FloatVectorWithConditionalTransform (the enable result) and the second point a2's field evidence are unverified.
Whether the force-feedback/action-binding tables are the only writers of dword_7D1B08/dword_7D1B0C is not established from this packet.
